statement: The product is software you run. We operate no hosted service that processes your data, so there are no subprocessors for your records.

categories.name: Distribution
categories.note: These carry the package and its metadata. No ledger, receipt, intent or customer identifier is ever sent to them by the software.

categories.name: Optional companion packages
items: sigil-profile depends on fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, rfc8785, cryptography, jsonschema
categories.note: Those libraries are installed by you, run on your hosts, and are not operated by us. gamai-mandate itself has no runtime dependencies (standard library only).

transfers: None by us. Nothing leaves the host that runs the software unless you configure an adapter (payment provider, ERP, mail) yourself.
change_policy: A new subprocessor would be a hosted service; we would announce it in the changelog before it exists, not after.
